_about: Official sources for the BinaSmart business-life knowledge pack (the third sector pack; the method is design 2026-09-16-airline-travel-design.md section 1, the scope is design 2026-09-17-business-pack-design.md). Four of its sites - motri, mols, poessa and etrade - are `fetch: "dir"`: their bytes were harvested by hand on 2026-09-17 from machines where those hosts answer, into /root/storage/packs/business-manual/<host>/, and the harvest never enters the repository. ops/packs/fetch-pack.js --pack business reads this file and nothing else: it fetches each site the way `fetch` says, keeps only paths matching `allow` and not matching `deny`, waits crawlDelaySeconds between requests, and writes knowledge/business/<slug>.md. This pack INFORMS ONLY. No page that files, submits, logs in, pays or applies is ever fetched, because Bini must never look like a way to register a business or lodge a declaration. reach/checked are what was measured from this VPS AND from a laptop in the UAE on the stated date; a source we cannot reach is listed as manual with the measurement and with what its absence costs, not deleted. `deadHosts` records domains that do not resolve so nobody chases them again. `references` names what the repository already holds so the pack never fetches the same thing twice - the repository rule is one source or the other, never both.

pack.disclaimerEn: Fees, thresholds, capital requirements, contribution rates and processing times change, often without notice. This is the page exactly as the institution published it on the date above. Confirm with the office before you act on any figure, and note that BinaSmart cannot see any register and cannot tell you whether your own licence or registration is valid.

pack.maskNoteEn: Phone numbers on this page are masked. Whoever holds a number can still recognise their own entry. Office lines and short codes are untouched. The page as the institution published it, every number complete, is at {url}.

pack._maskNote: maskPhones on a site masks every Ethiopian MOBILE number in its rendered body - 251 followed by 9 or 7, the Ethio Telecom and Safaricom ranges - down to its last four digits, and leaves office lines (251 followed by 1 to 5) and short codes such as 8482 or 6333 alone. The note above is added only to a document that actually holds a masked number, so the twenty pages of a maskPhones site that never carried a mobile number are not stamped with it. It is set on mols, whose /agencies register carries the personal mobile of the manager of each of 1,222 licensed overseas employment agencies, and on eic, whose about-eic pages carry named officials direct mobiles. The full numbers stay in the harvest at /root/storage/packs/business-manual/, which is not in the repository, and on the institutions own pages.
pack._headerNote: Added on 2026-09-17, after the Task 5 fetch wrote 62 documents and not one of them carried the disclaimer or the Source line: the registry had the two disclaimers but neither template, and header() fills templates - a pack with no template renders no header sentence at all. Found by reading a document, not by reading a log.

sites.name: Ministry of Trade and Regional Integration
sites.tlsNote: The certificate was read directly before any content was fetched. It is EXPIRED, not wrong-host: CN=*.mint.gov.et, issued by DigiCert Global G2 TLS RSA SHA256 2020 CA1, notAfter 2026-08-23, and its 59-entry shared Ethiopian-government SAN bundle does cover both *.motri.gov.et and the bare motri.gov.et. A verifying handshake fails with exactly one error, certificate has expired, and no other. Verification was disabled for THIS HOST ONLY; mols.gov.et and www.poessa.gov.et were fetched with verification on. ops/packs/fetch-pack.js refuses to build a site whose harvest records a relaxed handshake unless the registry declares it, which is what the tls field above is.
sites.robots: https://motri.gov.et/robots.txt - 200, the stock Drupal file, re-read during the harvest of 2026-09-17. It disallows /core/, /profiles/, /admin/, /comment/reply/, /filter/tips, /node/add/, /search/, /user/register, /user/password, /user/login, /user/logout and their /index.php/ twins. Nothing in this harvest is disallowed. No Crawl-delay is published, so the harvest paced at 6 s.
sites.sitemapNote: There is no sitemap. /sitemap.xml answers 200 with HTML (Drupal with no sitemap module); /wp-sitemap.xml and /sitemap_index.xml are 404, and /en/sitemap.xml and /am/sitemap.xml are Drupal soft-404s. Discovery was link-following from the home page, in both languages. Measured 2026-09-17.
sites.langNote: The most Amharic of the core sources. The home page extracts 2,904 characters of which 1,258 are Ethiopic (43 per cent), opening with the ministry name in Amharic and the words for online trade registration. The Amharic side of the site lives under /am and the English under /en, so the language is decided by the path and then checked against the text: the importer measures the Ethiopic share and only ever demotes am to en. Of the 38 Amharic pages in the harvest, all carry over 500 Ethiopic characters.
sites.reachNote: UP from a workstation and DEAD from this VPS, both measured on 2026-09-17. The host completes a TLS handshake and then presents a wildcard certificate for *.mint.gov.et that expired on 2026-08-23; Node fetch refuses it in 0.6 s with `fetch failed`, which is NOT a timeout and must not be retried as one, and plain http://motri.gov.et/ does not answer at all. The pack will not disable certificate verification to read a government page, so this site fetched 0 documents while it was a network site. It is now built from the harvest instead. Individual deep paths also time out when guessed - /am/node and /am/content/business-registration both did - which is why the harvest followed the home page links rather than guessing.
sites.why: Reachable, and not by this server. Measured 2026-09-17: motri.gov.et presents an expired wildcard certificate (see tls and reachNote), so the fetcher refuses it and the site contributed nothing for as long as it was a `sitemap`/`urls` entry. Its 79 pages and 66 PDFs were harvested on 2026-09-17 from a workstation where the host answers, with certificate verification disabled for this host alone, and copied to /root/storage/packs/business-manual/motri.gov.et (81.0 MB, every file SHA256-verified, 0 failures, 0 empty pages). The harvest never enters the repository; only the documents this importer writes are committed.
sites.costsUs: Nothing that the harvest does not now cover for the trade counter: the commercial-registration, trade-licence and trade-name service pages in both languages, the directorate and regional-office lists, and 19 of the ministry own proclamations, regulations and directives. What is still missing is everything the ministry publishes only as a photograph of paper - 21 of the 66 harvested PDFs, including Proclamation 1150/2019 (0 characters) and the file named 1343 (395 characters of CamScanner) - and the two bilingual gazettes whose Amharic column is a legacy non-Unicode font. See pdfNoTextLayerNote.
sites.allowPdfNote: A list, never a pattern: every one of the 19 rules above names one file. 66 PDFs were harvested from /sites/default/files/resource/ and each was read with pdftotext -layout on 2026-09-17 before it was allowed. 21 returned under 400 characters and are photographs of paper (see pdfNoTextLayerNote). 2 returned a long text layer whose Amharic column is a legacy non-Unicode font: 392_2016 (Commercial Registration and Licensing Council of Ministers Regulation No. 392/2016) gives 74,603 characters of which 154 are Ethiopic, and the Electronic Transaction Proclamation No. 1205/2020 gives 59,372 of which ONE is Ethiopic; the rest is punctuation soup, and the pack does not import text it cannot read. 24 are the Ethiopia Commodity Exchange own revised rules and their eleven amendments, which this registry already places out of scope for v1 under outOfScope ecx.com.et. The 19 that remain are the ministry own trade-registration, licensing, standards, fuel, cement, salt, pulses, sesame, livestock and border-trade instruments.
sites.pdfNoTextLayerNote: Photographs of paper, measured with pdftotext -layout on 2026-09-17 and NOT imported, with the characters each returned: proclamation_1150_2019 (0), 461-2012 Regulation (0), 1343 CamScanner 01-10-2025 (395), the file named mmriya (32), CamScanner 11-03-2025 (54), 535/2013 foreign trade fair licensing (17), 536/2013 chambers of commerce (8), 538/2013 khat export to Djibouti (17), 550/2013 merger directive (30), 552/2013 basic commodities - sugar, palm oil, wheat and wheat flour (17), 555/2013 impurity limits for exported oilseeds and pulses (26), 556/2013 the Ethiopian business licence classification schedule (26), 586/2013 standards technical committee allowances (17), 587/2013 WTO membership and regional trade negotiations (17), 869/2014 livestock trading system (26), the salt trading amendment draft 962/2015 (87), the cement trading repeal notice (32), the Ethiopian Metrology Institute establishment regulation (142), the Ethiopian Conformity Assessment Enterprise re-establishment regulation (43), the Ethiopian Standards Institute service fees regulation (109) and the standards preparation and implementation proclamation (395). Three of these - 556/2013, the licence classification schedule, and 535/2013 and 869/2014 - are exactly what a shopkeeper asks about, and the pack cannot answer from them. They are candidates for OCR on the same terms as the 99 National Bank directives of banking Task 15c: the files are in the harvest, nothing was invented for any of them, and no OCR was run in this task.

sites.pdfTitlesNote: The harvest manifest carries no title for any PDF, and the ministry file names are Amharic percent escapes, so each document is named here by hand. Sixteen are the ministry own file name, decoded and cleaned, with the directive number as the file writes it. Three are titled from the document own first page, read on 2026-09-17: Proclamation 980/2016 prints COMMERCIAL REGISTRATION AND BUSINESS LICENSING PROCLAMATION beside የንግድ ምዝገባና ፈቃድ አዋጅ; Regulation 377/2016 prints PULSES TRANSACTION COUNCIL OF MINISTERS REGULATION; and 935/2015 prints A DIRECTIVE TO PROVIDE FOR ... POST LICENSING INSPECTION beside its Amharic title. Nothing here is a summary and no number is changed. The Ethiopian year is NOT carried in either of the two gazette titles: the Negarit Gazette prints it in Ethiopic numerals - አዋጅ ቁጥር ፱፻፹/፪ሺ፰ ዓ.ም - and writing it as 2008 put a figure in the title that is nowhere on the page, which is what ops/packs/am-headers.js grounding check refused on 2026-09-17.
sites.pathSlugsNote: Two kinds of path cannot be named by rule here. The Amharic pages of this Drupal site transliterate to bare hyphens - /am/sector/--1/resources, /am/service_category/-/view, /am/partners/--2 - which are the real upstream paths and not a mangling on our side, and the slug rule would name three different sectors sector-1, sector-2 and sector-3. Each is named from the page own Amharic <title> as the harvest manifest recorded it on 2026-09-17. And /am and /en are named because the slug rule treats a leading two-letter segment as a locale prefix and drops it, which would leave both home pages with no name at all. The 19 PDFs are named because their file names are percent-encoded Amharic.
sites._sectionNote: sectionOf tests each regex against the PATH, and the Amharic paths of this site are bare hyphens, so the Amharic service-category pages are matched by their exact path rather than by a word. The rules section comes first because every allowed PDF sits under /sites/default/files/resource/ and its file name would otherwise fall into licensing or help by accident.

sites.sitemapNote: sitemap_index.xml lists 5 children: post-sitemap.xml, page-sitemap.xml, bricks_template-sitemap.xml, category-sitemap.xml, author-sitemap.xml. sites.langNote: No Amharic locale at all: the home page extracted 4,950 characters with ZERO Ethiopic characters. A single timeout is not a dead host: retry.

outOfScope.what: Federal Public Procurement and Property Authority. Reachable (home 4,777 characters, 14.7 percent Ethiopic, an Amharic title, an 18-child wp-sitemap.xml). Public procurement is BinaSmart own tender service, and pulling a procurement directive into a licence answer is exactly the cross-service confusion the intent tiers exist to prevent.

references.note: knowledge/eservices/ - 52 curated office catalogues from eservices.gov.et, including ministry-of-trade-and-regional-integration.md (6 services, 4,297 bytes), ethiopian-investment-commission.md, ethiopian-customs-commission.md, ministry-of-revenues.md, ethiopian-intellectual-property-authority.md, ministry-of-labor-and-skills.md, private-organization-employees-social-security-agency.md, ethiopia-electronics-single-window.md, ministry-of-industry.md, document-authentication-and-registration-service.md, accounting-and-auditing-board-of-ethiopia.md, federal-tax-appeal-commission.md, ethiopian-metrology-institute.md, ethiopian-construction-authority.md and authority-for-civil-society-organizations.md. They answer WHICH office and WHERE to apply, bilingually, in about 4 KB each. They do not answer how, what it costs or what to bring. This pack adds the procedure and never re-states the catalogue. eservices.gov.et itself is therefore not a site of this pack.

knowledge/law/ holds the statutes: vat-proclamation-1341-2024 (+ -am), income-tax-amendment-1395-2025 (+ -am), income-tax-regulation-410-2017, tax-administration-983-2016 and -amendment-1434-2026, tax-administration-regulation-407-2017, turnover-tax-308-2002, stamp-duty-110-1998-612-2008, customs-amendment-1425-2026 (+ -am), trade-competition-consumers-protection-813-2013, cooperative-societies-985-2016 (+ -am), labour-proclamation-1156-2019 (+ -om), urban-land-lease-721-2011 (+ -om), documents-authentication-registration-922-2015 (+ -am) and the tax directives 180-2015, 3-2011, 87-2005, 149-2011 and 189-2017. THE LAW TEXT STAYS IN law. The rule is law's and the counter is this pack's; that line is what the intent tiers of assistant/business.js encode. Note that there is NO investment proclamation or regulation in knowledge/law/ - investment incentives are genuinely new material here, not a duplicate.

knowledge/mor/mor-faqs.md and knowledge/mor/mor-forms.md - the Ministry of Revenue own FAQ and forms library plus bina.et/tax-forms, curated 2026-09-14 and preferred by Asmat since then. They answer which form de-registers a TIN, what a sales-register-machine owner must do and where a form is downloaded. This is why mor.gov.et is a manual site of this pack even on a day it answers: one source or the other, never both.

knowledge/web/ is knowledge/crawl.js output, driven by knowledge/sources-am.json, gitignored and TRUNCATED AT 20,000 CHARACTERS per document. On 2026-09-17 it held motri 40 pages, mols 37, eic 35, motl 30, ffic 12, fsc 12, and EMPTY directories for etrade, ecc, mor, daro, chamber, aacity, mint, moj and others. Task 2 of the business plan removes motri, mols and eic (and motl if it is taken) from knowledge/sources-am.json AND DELETES their knowledge/web/<site>/ directories, because knowledge/index.js reads every directory under knowledge/web regardless of the registry - the banking pack found that the hard way. knowledge/sources-am.json is itself gitignored, so this reference entry is the durable record of that change.

id.gov.et is crawled as `fayda` in knowledge/sources-am.json (34 pages in knowledge/web/fayda/) and summarised in public/fayda.html, which is in GUIDE_SLUGS. The national ID is a prerequisite for several business registrations, so the pack links to it and never re-fetches it. Measured 2026-09-17: /services 2,673 characters, /faq 948, zero Ethiopic in either - thin, and another reason not to duplicate it.

_corrections: Where an institution's page restates a rule that has since changed, the page is kept exactly as published and ops/packs/fetch-pack.js renderDoc inserts a labelled BinaSmart correction directly after the passage (match = a literal, or /regex/flags), with a one-line flag in the header. Every figure in noteEn and noteAm must appear in knowledge/law/<authorityDoc>.md or the render refuses. If match is no longer on the page the render logs [business] correction no longer matches <slug> and the weekly freshness note says so. Found 2026-09-18: asked the overtime rate, Bini answered 1.25x citing the Commission's FAQ over the law.

corrections.match: Overtime pay ranges from 1.25x hourly wage
corrections.noteEn: This page restates an outdated overtime rule. Under Article 68(1) of the Labour Proclamation 1156/2019 a worker is paid for overtime, in addition to the normal wage, at least 1.5 times the ordinary hourly rate for work between 6:00 a.m. and 10:00 p.m., 1.75 times for night work between 10:00 p.m. and 6:00 a.m., 2 times on the weekly rest day and 2.5 times on a public holiday; under Article 68(2) it is paid on the normal payday together with the wage.
corrections.noteAm: ይህ ገጽ ጊዜው ያለፈበትን የትርፍ ሰዓት ክፍያ ተመን ይደግማል። በሠራተኛና አሠሪ ሕግ አዋጅ ቁጥር 1156/2019 አንቀጽ 68(1) መሠረት የትርፍ ሰዓት ሥራ የሚሠራ ሠራተኛ ከመደበኛ ደመወዙ በተጨማሪ ለመደበኛ ሥራ በሰዓት ከሚከፈለው ደመወዝ ቢያንስ፦ ከንጋቱ 12 ሰዓት እስከ ምሽቱ 4 ሰዓት × 1.5፣ ከምሽቱ 4 ሰዓት እስከ ንጋቱ 12 ሰዓት × 1.75፣ በሳምንት የዕረፍት ቀን × 2፣ በሕዝብ በዓላት ቀን × 2.5 ይከፈለዋል፤ ክፍያው ለደመወዝ መክፈያ በተወሰነው ቀን ከደመወዝ ጋር ተደምሮ ይከፈላል (አንቀጽ 68(2))።
